overview.en:
Complete pinned catalog of official NVIDIA skills for GPU acceleration, CUDA, AI, data, training, inference, robotics, Physical AI, Omniverse, simulation, networking, and more.

Use official development workflows to inspect a project and plan a concrete implementation. Keep the framework, runtime, and requested change explicit when applying guidance.

Use this plugin in a Ghast conversation with the relevant inputs or project context. The bundled workflow guides the task; any required external tools or runtime must be available in your environment.
overview.zh-CN:
使用 NVIDIA 官方技能开展 GPU、CUDA、AI、机器人、仿真与推理开发。

使用官方开发工作流检查项目并规划具体实现，应用指导时明确框架、运行环境与所需变更。

在 Ghast 对话中提供相关输入或项目背景后使用本插件。随附流程会指导任务；所需外部工具或运行环境仍需在本机可用。

starterPrompts.en: Inspect this project and explain how to implement the requested feature.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 检查这个项目，说明如何实现所需功能。

starterPrompts.en: Diagnose this development error using the relevant official guidance.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 结合相关官方指导诊断这个开发错误。

starterPrompts.en: Review this code change and propose a focused verification plan.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 审查这段代码变更，提出有针对性的验证方案。
